extracted.name: Potato Spinach Casserole
extracted.description: This potato spinach casserole recipe uses mashed potatoes and chopped spinach, baked with sour cream, butter, and chives and topped with Cheddar cheese.
ingredient_lines: 1 (10 ounce) package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Grease a 2-quart casserole dish.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add potatoes; cook until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain and mash.
Combine mashed potatoes, spinach, sour cream, butter, green onions, salt, and black pepper in a large bowl; spoon into the prepared dish.
Bake in the preheated oven for 15 minutes. Top with Cheddar cheese; continue baking until cheese is melted, about 5 minutes more.
